propositions: Every verification index is rejected as unexpected when Pass-1 produces zero findings, causing all findings to degrade to INDETERMINATE despite a PASS verdict, creating undetected gate failures.

The root cause is verify_instructions() returning an imperative to emit verifications when handed an empty batch, leading to indices 0..N-1 in the response that are all marked unexpected against an empty valid_indices set.
INDETERMINATE findings from Pass-2 degradation cannot cause a BLOCK outcome and are silently absorbed if any advisory surfaces, masking unverified findings as passing.
The empty-batch path affected 43 stored review runs with zero LLM findings, all of which remained PASS with spurious contract violations logged to signed attestation coverage.

The fix replaces verify_instructions() empty-batch response with EMPTY_BATCH_INSTRUCTIONS requesting an empty verifications array, mirroring the prerequisite workflow contract and fixing the identical path in code_review_verify_inputs.
